sampleContracts.name: Service Agreement
sampleContracts.text: This Service Agreement is entered into between the parties. TERMINATION: Either party may terminate this agreement with 30 days written notice. PAYMENT TERMS: Client agrees to pay all invoices within 30 days. CONFIDENTIALITY: Both parties agree to maintain confidentiality.

sampleContracts.name: Employment Contract
sampleContracts.text: This Employment Contract outlines the terms of employment. LIABILITY: The employee shall be liable for any damages caused by negligence. INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY: All work created during employment belongs to the company. PAYMENT: Salary will be paid on the 15th of each month.
